objective.title: Qualify local M4 exact symbolic release gate

declared.summary: Qualify the local M4 symbolic preview through an independent six-phase science gate, all 12 tasks and 36 subtasks, focused and full .NET tests, three inspected local NuGet packages, and 32 isolated package-only consumer oracles. Preserve exact domains, provider limits and typed uncertainty. Complete only M4; keep M5 unstarted and make no public NuGet, stable API, cross-repository adoption or general CAS claim.
declared.value: Deliver independently checkable, locally packaged exact symbolic capabilities and explicit scientific limits before starting the separate M5 interoperability work.
debtChanges: Cross-check the six M4 phases, 12 accepted tasks and 36 subtasks against native DWF, canonical backlog, existing scientific evidence and prior M2/M3 gate receipts with a read-only C# validator.
After locked Release build, run focused symbolics, IR and quantities checks before the full admitted solution suite at this genuine milestone trust boundary.
Inspect three freshly packed local Math packages for net10 assemblies, nuspec metadata, direct dependency graph, actual bytes and SHA-256 without modifying workflow authority hashes.

Compile the 32-oracle NuGet-only gate consumer without dead local helpers (CS8321), then verify exact transformations, bounded execution, differentiation, real solving, original-root checks, integration and limits.
Write one M4 scientific gate receipt, complete only native M4 and backlog release M4, regenerate projections, and leave M5 not-ready without publishing any NuGet package.
Retain explicit nonclaims for foreign CAS, general complex/analytic calculus, arbitrary roots, public release, unobserved platforms, agent broker, Decision/MCDM and AURA adoption.
